title: Rabbi Chanina, Brother of Rabbi Mana (II)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 4, folio 13b: when his son died, Rabbi Mana asked Rabbi Yose whether the bed must be overturned.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5 speaks of the sons of Chanina, brother of Mana, dying and says “they asked Rabbi Yose.” Hyman’s supplied locator is 3:4, with historical folio 13b, and his account has one son and Mana asking. The historical folio is not mapped onto Bavli Moed Katan.

The whole Guggenheimer Moed Katan 3:5 paragraph explicitly writes Rabbi Mana, his brother Rabbi Chanina and Rabbi Yose. Those support the local full titles, while the sons/son and ‘they asked’/Mana asked differences remain exactly as explained in the retained note. Hyman’s 3:4 and historical folio 13b remain unchanged, without a new identity or genealogy decision.
